newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Philippines Petron seeks Sept diesel by tender.
newsitem.headline: Philippines Petron seeks Sept diesel by tender.

text.p: Petron Corp of the Philippines has emerged in the market to buy 20,000 tonnes of diesel for early September delivery, after buying an earlier cargo for August 10-20 delivery, traders said on Monday.
The tender for September requirement of 0.5-percent diesel, cost-and-freight Bataan basis, closes on Monday and is valid for one day.
Traders said Petron awarded the August tender to a South Korean refiner.
Petron had not issued a diesel import tender since early April 1996 when a shutdown forced it to seek supplies.
It was a regular buyer two to three years ago, seeking 300,000 barrels a month.
Traders said the additional requirements might be due to the unscheduled shutdown of a 150,000-barrel-per-day thermal cracker on June 20 after an explosion.
The unit, which produces diesel, gasoline and liquefied petroleum gas, is due to restart during mid-August.
The September requirement is also due to a supply shortfall while Petron shuts down an 85,000-bpd crude unit and a 17,000-bpd reformer during September 1-12.
